# digibib5-mcp

> FastMCP Digitale Bibliothek 5 reader: reverse-engineered DKI volumes (TOC, decoded text, FTS5 search, figure scans) + React/Vite reader (ports 14114/14115).

**Full doc (tools, env, packaging, troubleshooting):** [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt)

## Entry

- Python package: `src/digibib5_mcp/` — `server.py` (`digibib` portmanteau tool, stdio), `api.py` (Starlette REST on 14115), `dki/` (volume/TOC/codec/search/images).
- Web: `web_sota/` — React + Vite + Tailwind reader on 14114 (proxies `/api` to 14115).
- Docs: `README.md`, `INSTALL.md`, `docs/` (CONFIGURATION, TOOLS, DEVELOPMENT, TROUBLESHOOTING, ONBOARDING).
- Library root env: `DIGIBIB_ROOT` (default `K:\Digitale Bibliothek\Bibliothek`).

## Tools (`digibib` op)

`list_volumes` | `descriptor` | `toc` | `node_text` (chapter extent + images) | `record_text` | `search` (FTS5 + snippets) | `images` (figure list + REST urls)

## Security

- No network calls, no keys, no accounts — everything is local disc data.
- `image_bytes()` validates file names against traversal (`^[A-Za-z0-9]+\.bmp$`); figure serving 404s on missing levels.
- Decoded disc text is treated as data, not instructions.
